name: tester-reporter-ai
description: Record a manual QA session and get a video, a runnable Playwright script, and an AI-written bug report.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && xvfb-run -a --server-args='-screen 0 1280x900x24' bash -c 'openbox --sm-disable & sleep 1; exec node --env-file-if-exists=.env --test --test-concurrency=1 e2e/licence.e2e.mjs e2e/permissions.e2e.mjs e2e/session.e2e.mjs e2e/bench.e2e.mjs e2e/roundtrip.e2e.mjs'
scripts.test:e2e:site: npm run build && xvfb-run -a --server-args='-screen 0 1280x900x24' bash -c 'openbox --sm-disable & sleep 1; exec node --test --test-concurrency=1 e2e/orangehrm.e2e.mjs'
scripts.test:e2e:ai: npm run build && xvfb-run -a --server-args='-screen 0 1280x900x24' bash -c 'openbox --sm-disable & sleep 1; exec node --env-file-if-exists=.env --test --test-concurrency=1 e2e/full-pipeline.e2e.mjs'
scripts.test:all: npm run verify && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:video && npm run test:e2e:perf && npm run test:e2e:site && npm run test:live && npm run test:e2e:ai && npm run test:e2e:video-ai
scripts.test:e2e:video: npm run build && xvfb-run -a --server-args='-screen 0 1280x900x24' bash -c 'openbox --sm-disable & sleep 1; exec node --test --test-concurrency=1 e2e/video.e2e.mjs'
scripts.test:e2e:perf: npm run build && xvfb-run -a --server-args='-screen 0 1280x900x24' bash -c 'openbox --sm-disable & sleep 1; exec node --test --test-concurrency=1 e2e/perf.e2e.mjs'
scripts.test:e2e:video-ai: npm run build && xvfb-run -a --server-args='-screen 0 1280x900x24' bash -c 'openbox --sm-disable & sleep 1; exec node --env-file-if-exists=.env --test --test-concurrency=1 e2e/video-ai.e2e.mjs'
